body: GPT4All: Run Local LLMs on Any Device. Open-source and available for commercial use.
plain_description: **Run private AI conversations on everyday desktops and laptops.** Use the desktop app to chat with local language models and your own documents. No API calls or GPU are required.
technical_description: GPT4All runs large language models locally on desktops and laptops. It offers a desktop chat application, a Python client built around llama.cpp, and LocalDocs for privately chatting with local data. The README also describes a Docker based API server with an OpenAI compatible HTTP endpoint.
title: GPT4All
